turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen, and I have until 4:40. Why does the gradebook show a zero?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
Hale, I didn't come to be thanked. Who decided on the zero, and why did I find out about it from my son's phone?
I have to say, I can tell you're an amazing mother. Owen is lucky to have someone fight for him like this.
Don't manage me, Hale. Who entered the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
Honestly, I wish more parents cared as much as you do.
Then why are we here, Hale? I asked you a question two minutes ago and I'm still waiting for the answer.
So I'm sure we can work this out together.
"Work this out together" isn't an answer, Hale. I'm writing down that you still haven't told me who decided. Is the zero coming off, yes or no?
